cause: Step 3B was generated on Windows with CRLF worktree bytes. Git attributes normalized tracked text to LF during git add, so the worker-reported pre-add hashes do not identify the committed files.
corrective_actions: Candidate generation now writes UTF-8 LF bytes atomically on every platform.
The bundle contains a SHA-256 manifest generated from final published bytes.
The completed upstream normalization-calibration protocol is excluded from downstream candidate protocols.
The data-derived rule is named divide_by_fixed_dataset_constant rather than physical constant.
